services.story: The main story: a home hearing check for Alex with Tomas. Nothing is taken. The office bills Alex's plan its own way.

services.name: Home hearing check
services.story: The same home hearing check, paid by Alex: nothing is taken, and Rosie texts the $165 bill when Tomas texts DONE.

services_shape: visits of a set length, booked with an ENT surgeon or an audiologist by name; a new patient's consult is longer and the owner OKs it; follow-ups are booked by text for current patients; a hearing test is its own visit; an office procedure is added at a visit only with the patient's yes; same-day sick visits open each morning for current patients first; a home hearing check has a 2-hour arrival window
questions_before_times: a new or a current patient
which visit: the practice's own visit types only, never a symptom or a reason typed into the AI
a plan (its name only) or self-pay
for a video follow-up: which state the patient will be in
who the visit is for: the person booking, a child (3 and up), or another adult
safety_stop: trouble breathing or swallowing, a throat that is swelling shut, drooling with trouble breathing, or bleeding from the nose or mouth that won't stop
chest pain, signs of a stroke (a drooping face, a weak arm, slurred speech, a sudden severe headache), fainting, or sudden severe dizziness with a fall
an overdose, or swallowed medicine or a chemical
first_steps: Health history, medicines, the consent and the privacy notice
A written price estimate for self-pay patients
Records and past hearing tests from the last doctor
A referral, where the plan asks for one
Sam's OK for a new patient
license: optional: the business may add any license or registration it holds (a clinician's, a practice's); Rosie never requires one and never looks one up
staff_skills: the ENT surgeon (Mara): new patient consults, follow-ups, sick visits, office procedures and video follow-ups; the audiologists (Ivan at the office, Tomas at home): hearing tests and home hearing checks; the nurse (Lia): sick visit support and home visits; only people the owner clears for home visits go to homes
messages_never: texts carry only the practice's name, the date, the time, the address and a secure link: never the visit type, the reason, the body part, symptoms, medicines, results or the clinician's name (at a home visit the clinician's name stays, for the door check)
demo_note: Demo data for testing only. [G] = prefilled from the business's Google listing at sign-up; the owner checks each field.
